name: The Butterfly Effect Garden
description: A garden where every butterfly's wingbeat causes colorful ripples in reality, changing the colors of flowers and the patterns in the sky.
prompt: An enchanted garden where dozens of iridescent butterflies flutter through air thick with visible color waves. Each delicate wingbeat sends ripples of vibrant energy that transform nearby flowers - roses shift from red to blue, sunflowers brighten to gold, tulips pulse with electric patterns. The butterflies' paths create temporary art in the sky, painting swirling designs that fade like smoke rings. Lush vegetation frames the magical chaos with hyper-realistic detail. Bright saturated colors, kinetic energy visualization, fantasy botanical art.
caption: Every flutter changes everything - welcome to the garden where butterflies paint reality itself! 🦋🎨
